items.title: Senior Account Executive
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000 across Sweden, Denmark and Norway in telecommunications, financial services, industrial manufacturing, energy and utilities, and healthcare and life sciences. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. As a Senior Account Executive, you will: - Drive net-new customer acquisition across Sweden, Denmark and Norway via targeted outbound activity, executive introductions, and relationship building with key stakeholders - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach, technical and business validation, through deal close - Support coverage of adjacent Nordic accounts as territory priorities require - Generate and own your own pipeline through disciplined outbound, research and executive prospecting - Be a trusted advisor to customer prospects, deeply understand their challenges & goals, and tailor solutions to drive impact for their businesses - Leverage senior-level relationships with executives to drive strategic partnerships and sales opportunities - Align closely with our partners and systems integrators to drive shared revenue and extend reach into target accounts - Work cross-functionally across the business, drawing in the right technical and specialist colleagues as each engagement requires - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives and Marketing to supplement your own top of funnel activity You may be a good fit if you have: - Fluent in at least one Nordic language – Swedish, Norwegian or Danish – in addition to English; additional Nordic languages are a strong advantage - 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprise customers along with experience negotiating & closing transformational 7-figure deals - Depth in at least two of our priority sectors: financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences - A hunter mentality - you take pride in generating your own pipeline and are at your best when building a territory rather than managing an inherited one - A proven track record of high performance and exceeding quotas - Experience building and maintaining senior-level relationships with executives - Experience working alongside channel partners and systems integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - Excellent communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others & building strong relationships, experienced presenting to a C-suite audience, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical customer prospects Additional Requirements: - Experience selling complex enterprise level solutions, technical products, and private or on-premise deployments (AI/NLP solutions preferred) - Familiarity with European data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements as live buying criteria - High tolerance for ambiguity - this is an early-stage territory without an established local playbook, and you'll need to be both a doer and a strategist - Creativity - deal structures can widely vary, strong technical acumen and the ability to creatively structure mutually beneficial partnerships are necessary FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

We are committed to staying at the forefront of technological advancements, continually pushing boundaries and delivering seamless entertainment and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base. items.title: SMB Innovation Sales & Strategy Lead
items.description: About the Team OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways. The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth. About the Role The SMB Innovation Sales & Strategy Lead will identify, incubate and scale new revenue opportunities across OpenAI’s SMB Ads business. This foundational role combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor and hands-on execution to develop differentiated customer propositions, validate product opportunities and launch new go-to-market programs. Working across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Data Science, this person will lead initiatives from opportunity assessment through customer discovery, commercial pilots and transition to scale. The remit includes industry-specific opportunities, differentiated customer engagement models and innovative approaches across self-serve, sales-assisted and partner-led channels. The lead will also partner with SMB leadership and the Strategy & Operations team to inform the overall SMB strategy, contributing customer segmentation, commercial insights and evidence from incubation programs to broader planning and investment decisions. In This Role, You Will - Identify untapped opportunities across SMB segments, industries, and channels. Build business cases and launch pilots to validate customer demand and commercial potential. - Design new acquisition, activation, and expansion programs, including industry-specific and assisted-growth approaches. Partner with sales teams and outsourced sales providers to connect self-serve adoption with sales-assisted engagement. - Translate customer discovery into product opportunities. Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate solutions and use customer and commercial evidence to guide investment. - Develop actionable SMB segmentation based on needs, business characteristics, advertising maturity, behavior, growth potential, and economics. Tailor acquisition, onboarding, service, and expansion across customer channels. - Own pilot delivery and measurement across incremental revenue, conversion, customer outcomes, and cost to serve. Scale successful programs through clear playbooks and ownership; refine or retire those that miss defined success criteria. - Shape SMB strategy and investment recommendations with leadership and Strategy & Operations, drawing on market analysis, segmentation, and pilot results. - Lead the innovation portfolio through clear roadmaps, performance measures, and decision milestones. Resolve delivery challenges and transition proven programs into ongoing operations. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Bring approximately 8-10 years of experience in business incubation, growth, strategy, business operations, product strategy, or consulting, with substantial ownership of implementation and commercial results. - Understand SMB customers and self-serve business models, including how sales-assisted and partner-led approaches support growth. - Demonstrate success taking initiatives from customer insight and business case through pilot, launch, and measurable impact. - Apply strong analytical and financial modeling skills across opportunity sizing, unit economics, funnel analysis, and experimentation. - Translate customer segmentation into differentiated propositions, engagement models, and investment decisions. - Work directly with customers to uncover needs and shape product and go-to-market recommendations. - Lead cross-functional initiatives, align senior stakeholders, and resolve competing priorities. - Combine strategic analysis with hands-on customer discovery, pilot delivery, and program execution. - Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments and move effectively across complex organizations. Preferred Experience - Bring experience in advertising platforms, marketplaces, or SMB technology businesses. - Combine management consulting experience with substantial hands-on operating responsibility. - Draw on experience in both established technology companies and startups. - Build on experience with outsourced sales channels, sales-assisted growth, or industry-specific commercial programs. Workplace & Location - San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Senior Affiliate Manager
items.description: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a dedicated Senior Affiliate Manager to join our team in Armenia! About the role: The Senior Affiliate Manager (Tier 1) is a high-ownership role within the PartnerMatrix Managed Services (AMS) team. This person takes full responsibility for a portfolio of iGaming operator clients in established, high-competition markets — managing their affiliate programs end-to-end, growing affiliate traffic, and delivering measurable NGR impact across Tier 1 GEOs including the UK, Germany, Sweden, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, etc. The role requires deep industry expertise, strong affiliate relationships, and the ability to operate independently in regulated environments. What you'll get to do: Client Affiliate Program Management • Own and manage affiliate programs for several assigned iGaming operator clients from day one. • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned operators, regular calls, strategy alignment, performance reviews. • Define and execute affiliate program strategy: GEO targets, payout models (CPA / RevShare / Hybrid), traffic mix goals. • Set up, configure, and maintain affiliate programs within the PartnerMatrix (PMA) platform. • Proactively identify and action program improvements; escalate blockers to the Head of Managed Services and Marketing with proposed solutions. Affiliate Recruitment & Relationship Management • Identify, outreach and onboard high-quality affiliates matching each operator's target GEO and vertical. • Build and maintain strong working relationships with affiliates — be the trusted partner they call first. • Negotiate CPA rates, RevShare deals, and hybrid structures on behalf of operators within approved guidelines. • Run regular check-ins with top-performing affiliates; identify upsell and cross-program opportunities. • Maintain an updated affiliate pipeline per client, track deal status and conversion from outreach to activation. Operational Excellence & Compliance • Ensure all managed affiliates have completed KYC/AML onboarding before activation without exceptions. • Monitor affiliate traffic quality daily, flag fraud signals, bonus abuse patterns, unusual conversion spikes. • Coordinate payment data reconciliation with Finance; review payout files before submission. • Manage affiliate communications via PMA ticketing system; maintain sub-24h response SLA. • Maintain accurate documentation of affiliate deals, contracts and status in the CRM. Reporting & Performance Analysis • Deliver weekly performance reports to each assigned operator (traffic, FTDs, conversions, NGR impact). • Conduct monthly strategy review calls with operators; present data-driven recommendations. • Track KPIs: active affiliate count, payout-to-NGR ratio, new FTDs/month, affiliate retention rate. • Feed insights back to Head of MS for cross-client benchmarking and program strategy refinement. • Contribute to quarterly competitive landscape reviews, flag shifts in affiliate market, rates or GEO trends. Team Contribution • Mentor and support Middle Affiliate Managers — share playbooks, deal structures, GEO learnings. • Document processes and best practices for team knowledge base. • Participate in team calls, contribute to pricing decisions and product feedback for PMA development. What we're looking for: • 3+ years in affiliate management in iGaming • Proven track record of building and growing affiliate programs, not just maintaining them • Hands-on experience with at least one iGaming affiliate platform • Strong existing network of iGaming affiliates across Tier 1 markets (UK, DACH, Nordics, Canada, ANZ) • Understanding of CPA, RevShare and Hybrid commission models, can structure and negotiate deals independently • Fluent in English; German, Swedish, Dutch or French is a significant advantage • Comfortable with data — able to read affiliate reports, spot anomalies, and draw actionable conclusions • Familiarity with regulated market compliance requirements (UKGC, MGA, Spelinspektionen) Nice-to-Have • Experience managing multi-brand or multi-GEO affiliate programs simultaneously • Familiarity with AML/KYC requirements for payment flows in iGaming • Knowledge of Tier 2 or emerging market affiliate ecosystems (CIS, LatAm, MENA) Here's what we offer: · Start with 24 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 34 days by your fifth year with us. · Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment, with up to 50 days of work from home per year. · Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. · Access online learning platform like Udemy for Business and a budget for external training. · Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. · Private Medical Subscription. · Gym allowance. · Team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Partnerships Operations Lead, OAI for Government
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government helps public-sector institutions use advanced AI responsibly to improve services and advance critical missions. The Partnerships team builds the external ecosystem and internal operating mechanisms required to deliver that work at scale. Role Summary We are seeking a Partnerships Operations Lead to build and run the operating foundation for OpenAI for Government’s Partnerships team. This person will serve as the operational connective tissue across the partner team, working closely with Account Directors, Solutions Architects, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and other cross-functional stakeholders to move opportunities from initial engagement through agreement and execution. They will help ensure a smooth handoff to Technical Success across accounts by establishing clear readiness criteria, capturing the right commercial and customer context, and aligning teams on partner roles, commitments, dependencies, and success outcomes. The ideal candidate is a true utility player who combines the relationship instincts of a growth oriented builder with the rigor of an exceptional business operator. They thrive in ambiguity, create processes that do not yet exist, and move fluidly between deal execution, workflow design, analysis, and cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities - Own the end-to-end operating cadence for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities, from intake and qualification through approvals, contracting, launch, and expansion. - Build and continuously improve operating processes, standard procedures, stage gates, decision rights, and service expectations that make partner execution faster and more predictable. - Operationalize new and existing government partner motions—including cloud providers, resellers, and sell-through models—by translating requirements that differ from standard commercial motions into clear workflows, enablement, decision rights, and cross-functional handoffs. - Coordinate deal execution across Account Directors, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Security and Compliance, Product, Technical Success, and partner teams, ensuring every action has a clear owner and timeline. - Establish a consistent handoff from commercial teams to Technical Success by standardizing readiness criteria, account context, use cases, partner responsibilities, commitments, dependencies, and success plans. - Unblock complex deals by surfacing issues early, driving approvals and escalations, managing exceptions, and closing gaps between functions. - Maintain the operational source of truth for contract milestones, partner launches, handoff readiness, dependencies, and risks, with a high bar for process and data quality; coordinate with Revenue Operations to ensure partner context is reflected in pipeline and CRM data. - Own the government-partner operating cadences for deal execution, launch tracking, and business reviews; coordinate with Revenue Operations on pipeline and forecasting inputs and turn the resulting data into concise insights and actions. - Identify and implement workflow, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce cycle time, eliminate recurring friction, and enable the partner team to scale. Qualifications - 7+ years of experience in operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, go-to-market business operations, or complex program management. - A track record of building operating processes and cross-functional workflows from the ground up in a fast-moving organization. - Experience supporting the end-to-end deal lifecycle in enterprise technology, public sector, or another complex and regulated environment. - Exceptional program-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple high-priority workstreams, stakeholders, decisions, and deadlines. - Strong systems and data orientation, including experience with CRM, reporting, workflow, and collaboration tools. - Ability to move between detailed execution and systems-level problem solving without losing speed, accuracy, or accountability. - Excellent written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority. NICE TO HAVE - Experience operating partner, alliance, channel, or co-sell programs in enterprise technology, cloud, or AI. - Familiarity with public-sector procurement, government contracting, and customer implementation or Technical Success handoffs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are a true utility player. You are comfortable moving between process design, deal problem-solving, analysis, documentation, and hands-on coordination. - Are a builder. You see ambiguity as an invitation to create clear, durable systems that help teams operate better. - Are deal-oriented. You understand what makes complex opportunities move, anticipate bottlenecks, and bring urgency to the critical path. - Are a cross-functional connector. You translate clearly among commercial, operational, legal, financial, and technical stakeholders and keep teams aligned. - Are a systems thinker. You look for root causes, remove recurring friction, and use data and automation to improve how work gets done. - Take ownership with low ego. You are calm under pressure, highly reliable, and willing to do whatever is needed to help the team and its customers succeed. items.title: Gaming Commercial Manager - Spain
items.description: Reporting to the Head of Commercial within the Spanish Business Unit, the Gaming Commercial Manager will play a key role in driving and overseeing the Gaming proposition for our regulated Spanish portfolio. The successful candidate will help ensure that our Gaming offering consistently meets the expectations and demands of the Spanish customer base, balancing long-term customer value with strong commercial performance and revenue optimisation across Casino, Live Casino, Slots and other Gaming verticals. This role requires close collaboration with local teams across Campaigns, Marketing, CRM and Operations, as well as central functions including Compliance, Legal, Product Development, BI and external Gaming providers. Together with senior stakeholders, the Gaming Commercial Manager will help shape and execute the commercial strategy across all Gaming products and brands operating in Spain, currently including William Hill and 888. The role holder will be a subject matter expert in the Spanish Gaming landscape, customer behaviours, market trends and competitor propositions, ensuring our product and commercial strategy remains competitive, innovative and customer-centric. A key aspect of the role will involve aligning promotional and customer engagement strategies around key commercial moments, seasonal campaigns and player behaviours, while also supporting initiatives that maximise customer value and improve retention. What you’ll be doing : ﻿ Monitor daily Gaming P&L and key commercial KPIs across the Spanish market, identifying performance gaps and implementing action plans to improve results. Develop and evolve a compelling, market-leading Gaming proposition tailored to Spanish customers. Collaborate with Product teams to support the implementation of new Gaming features and enhancements aligned with customer needs and market trends. Partner closely with BI and Analytics teams to analyse customer behaviour, identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable commercial initiatives. Work alongside CRM, Site and Product teams to optimise customer journeys, engagement and long-term player value. Coordinate with CRM and Customer Engagement teams to align promotional strategies with KPIs performance, personalised offers and Gaming campaigns. Monitor customer satisfaction metrics including NPS and customer feedback to improve the overall Gaming experience. Collaborate with Compliance and Legal teams to ensure Gaming propositions remain fully compliant with Spanish regulations while maintaining a strong customer experience. Work closely with external Gaming suppliers and internal stakeholders to optimise game portfolio performance and promotional visibility. Conduct regular competitor analysis to ensure our Gaming offering remains differentiated and market leading. Support additional commercial and operational initiatives as required. Basic Governance & Operating Rhythm Daily monitoring of all Gaming performance KPIs across 888 Casino and William Hill Casino, segmented by product vertical and customer segment. Weekly meetings with BI and Analytics teams to review campaign performance, retention, reactivation and churn metrics. Weekly meetings with VIP teams to review high-value customer segment performance and key customer actions. Weekly alignment with William Hill and 888 Proposition Managers to coordinate Marketing and CRM priorities for upcoming Gaming activity. Biweekly meetings with Product and Gaming Operations teams to review game performance, promotional mechanics, supplier priorities and customer experience improvements. Weekly meetings with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all Gaming propositions, campaigns and customer communications remain aligned with regulatory requirements. Weekly coordination with GMS and Site teams to prioritise onsite Gaming content, lobbies, banners and promotional placements in line with market strategy and commercial priorities. Regular collaboration with external Gaming providers to maximise commercial opportunities, exclusive content visibility and game performance. Who we are looking for: ﻿Essential Minimum 3 years’ experience in iGaming, Online Casino, Product Marketing, Commercial Management or related commercial roles. Strong understanding of Gaming commercial drivers and customer behaviour. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets and convert insights into actionable recommendations. Strong understanding of the Spanish Gaming and entertainment landscape. Ability to translate customer needs into business requirements and commercial action plans. Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong communication and influencing capabilities. Proactive, solution-oriented and agile mindset. Native-level Spanish and fluent English (written and spoken). Preferred Experience within regulated Gaming or iGaming environments. Knowledge of Casino, Live Casino and Slots products. Experience working with Gaming suppliers and third-party providers. Familiarity with BI and reporting tools. *Please provide an English CV with your application. ﻿ What we offer: Our roles offer more than just a job, you’ll become part of the evoke family! We have created an environment where our people can thrive. Check out some of the fantastic benefits on offer: Financial: Competitive salary; Hybrid working: Our employees can work from home up to 80% of the time with 20% of office time built in to ensure we get some face-to-face collaborative team time - and the chance for a coffee and a catch-up!; Holiday entitlement; eLearning; Family Support: Industry-leading maternity and paternity leave and paid time off if you have caring responsibilities; Health & wellbeing: Tools and services to help support your well-being, including support with mental health and financial education. You will also have access to gym discounts; Healthcare: We prioritize your health and well-being, offering comprehensive healthcare benefits; ...and more. More about evoke We’re a business that embraces change and progress. The power behind big name brands William Hill, 888, and Mr Green, evoke is the new name for 888 Holdings. Marking a new sense of purpose, direction, and ambition for the business, there couldn’t be a more exciting time to join us as we accelerate our journey to bring even greater delight to our customers with world-class betting and gaming experiences. That’s the future. That’s evoke . At evoke, you’ll benefit from flexibility and a culture built on trust. We’ll give you the space to be yourself and the tools you need to protect our customers while they play. We’ll invest in your future to help you develop your unique strengths and build a career that’s right for you. Apply At evoke, we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion for the benefit of our company, employees, and communities. We foster a welcoming and safe workplace that values all forms of diversity and provides opportunities for growth. Sound good? Then you belong at our place! items.title: Account Manager Lead - Corporate
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest-velocity, highest-volume post-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast-moving book of accounts. This is a revenue-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first - more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well. The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook. You will: - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high-volume book of business. - Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate - building a team culture where expansions and cross-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota-carrying sales function. - Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful. - Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount. - Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI-powered approaches to their work. - Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership. - Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high-volume, transactional or corporate-segment books of business. - Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct. - 2+ years of direct people leadership experience - managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high-performance, feedback-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact. - Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed. - Strong player-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios. - Expertise in post-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high-volume, scaled motion. - Strategic operational thinking: able to make sound calls on segmentation, playbook design, and process at scale as account volume grows. - Strong analytical and operational skills: adept at using data to identify performance trends, optimize workflows, and forecast outcomes across a large book. - Bonus: Hands-on with tools (ElevenLabs, Salesforce, Gong, Lemlist, Sigma) and capable of improving data quality, visibility, and usage insights across the team. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the U.S., with the ability to operate between GMT-4 and GMT-7 timezones required. items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. THE ROLE: The Media Buying Cluster Lead is essential for the design, configuration, and optimization of all media buying campaigns. This role involves collaboration with Business Development and Account Management teams to define campaign objectives, and subsequently own trading strategies to support a range of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The Lead will be responsible for implementing the campaign setup, continuously monitoring performance, and making necessary adjustments to achieve optimal results. A core function is also to produce detailed, insightful reports for clients detailing campaign performance. Whilst also managing a cluster of media buyers responsible for a book of clients predominantly in real-money gaming, sports betting and performance-led brands. You will be accountable for the KPI outcomes on those accounts as well as your teams’ executional consistency. You will report to the VP of Programmatic Trading and work alongside cluster leads in London, Tallinn and Medellín as part of a single global trading practice Team & Client Management: Own the performance, manage the bandwidth, lead and develop your media buying cluster Coach traders through live optimization decisions to drive self sufficiency and skill growth. Run onboarding and ongoing training for new traders, and act as the escalation point for complex or at-risk campaigns in the cluster. Seamlessly manage team members and their direct communications with clients and other stakeholders, ensuring high-quality standards and timely problem resolution with excellent service. Conduct training for new staff and adjacent stakeholders in client services and sales teams Campaign Strategy & Execution: Serve as the senior trading on our largest accounts and own campaign architecture, bidding strategy, supply strategy, budget pacing and KPI performance. Create and execute client campaigns based on available data, audience segments, creative assets, and required targeting. Liaise with our global media planner to execute comprehensive campaign plans tailored to the nature of each campaign. Drive lower-funnel outcomes across acquisition and retention goals, diagnose CPA and ROAS shortfalls to enhance campaign performance. Analyze recorded data and implement changes, settings, or modifications to improve the efficiency of the clients' inventory serving pattern. Analyze, present, and execute strategic offerings to clients to enhance performance across all media channels. Reporting & Optimization: Review and fully understand client reporting tools and attribution models to ensure accurate optimizations and generate value for clients within the cluster. Create insightful reports for managed campaigns, including in-depth deep dives and recaps for weekly meetings. Leadership Codify modern trading principles into documented playbooks and build processes to support a growing business across clusters. Drive consistency in campaign setup, naming, taxonomy, whitelisting and optimization cadence. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 4+ years of experience in programmatic media buying, digital advertising, or ad tech, with a strong track record in trading leadership roles. Deep expertise in DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, DMPs, and data-driven trading strategies. (TTD, Amazon DSP, Moloco and Beeswax in particular). A demonstrable track record on lower funnel acquisition campaigns - you can walk through an account you turned around and explain exactly what you changed and why. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions. Basic knowledge understanding and experience is social and walled gardens (Meta, Snap, X and Google Ads) Ability to manage accounts with multiple activity types and complex setups (Acquisition, Branding, Retention, etc). Ability to run standard queries to extract data relevant to the managed campaign, provide insights based on the extracted data. Clear and strategic understanding and knowledge of inventory partners and SSPs. items.title: Senior Account Executive
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role, you will have ownership of the full sales cycle - from identifying leads to closing deals with Global 2000, large enterprises within Western Canada. We’re looking for an approachable and compelling communicator who loves working with prospects to uncover their needs and feels comfortable developing tailored value propositions around how Cohere’s platform can help them achieve their business goals. You’ll lay the foundation for Cohere’s growth by owning your territory and collaborating with teammates across customer success, sales development, marketing, and solution architecture. You’ll be the voice of the field and help our product and engineering teams prioritize the Cohere roadmap with customer-centric care. It’s a highly self-directed role, so you should be someone who thrives in an unstructured and quickly evolving environment. And your opportunity for impact will be astronomical — Cohere has skies-the-limit potential, and you’ll help us reach it. As an Account Executive you will: - Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity and relationship building with key stakeholders while also bringing a strong network of key decision-maker and influencer contacts to drive strategic partnerships and win sales opportunities - Work closely with customers and prospects as a consultative, trusted advisor who deeply understands their challenges and goals, their technology ecosystem, and will tailor solutions to drive measurable impact for their businesses - Work in close partnership with channel partners to find opportunities to scale outreach and customer satisfaction in your region - Collaborate with product and engineering teams as well as customer success on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers - Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity - Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach through proof-of-concept, deal close, and deployment ; this is not a transactional sale that you can walk away from after the contract is signed but rather requires ongoing oversight of the project to ensure success You may be a good fit if you have: - 8-12+ years of previous B2B sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprises negotiating and closing transformational multi-year (2-5 year) SaaS deals in the 7 figure range, and a track record of high performance and exceeding quota - Previous experience as a technical consultative salesperson, selling complex products, such as developer tools, API products, or AI / NLP solutions, are a plus. - Previous experience working with customers during the deployment phase of the engagement, aligning on how best to configure and customize the solution that supports success in production and builds trust to set up for expansion and growth - Previous experience working with channel partners such as cloud hyperscalers and system integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals - High tolerance for ambiguity - as an early sales hire, you’ll have to be a self-starter, doer and a strategist who is capable of wearing many hats and doing what it takes to figure out a path to success - Curiosity - you want to go deep on NLP and become an expert on our technology while considering how to fit into a large organization’s technology landscape - Fantastic communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others, build strong relationships, can speak to the c-suite, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences Additional Requirements: - Deep understanding of the enterprise landscape, including key trends, challenges, and opportunities - Ability to articulate the value of AI and NLP solutions in the context of Fortune 2000 operations. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com THE ROLE: This is a heavy, hands-on sales role. You will live inside your assigned holding-company agencies, working directly with client buying and planning teams, and building relationships across investment, strategy, and programmatic teams, to personally lead deals end-to-end. You'll work side-by-side with Sales Enablement, Ad Operations, and our Insights team to translate our products into solutions your clients need. What You'll Do Own your pipeline and quota Own and exceed an individual quota across your assigned holding-company agency and brand-client portfolio. Personally source, lead, and close deals; running discovery, ideation, pitch, negotiation, and contracting. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline at 3x+ coverage; keep CRM (Salesforce) accurate and current at all times. Translate our Moments framework; Mindsets, Pre-Game anticipation, Real-Time In-Game, Post-Game sentiment into clear, repeatable narratives that planners and media buyers can confidently pitch to their brand clients. Build and own holding-company agency relationships Build and own day-to-day relationships across your assigned holding-company agencies; Investment Directors, Planning Directors, Programmatic Leads, Strategy Leads, Connections Planners, and brand-team contacts. Map and multi-thread each assigned agency: investment, planning, programmatic, strategy, and brand-aligned teams. Partner with the VP, Sales for your assigned holding company on holdco-level joint business plans; execute the agency-level workstreams that bring those plans to life. Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for your accounts and the liaison to Genius Ad Ops, Insights, and Client Services for flawless campaign execution. Execute and grow the book Drive expansion of our audience and moments solutions across every buying method your holding company uses; programmatic, PMP, and direct/guaranteed, working hands-on with the agency's buying and planning teams. Partner with Account Management to ensure retention and renewal for every client in your book; build the case for year-over-year growth. Operate with discipline: weekly pipeline reviews, accurate forecasts (within ±10%), tight follow-up, and clean CRM hygiene. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: 7+ years selling advertising, ad-tech, or media to agencies, with direct experience inside a major holding-company ecosystem (Omnicom, WPP, Publicis, IPG, Dentsu, or Independent Agencies). Track record of personally closing six- and seven-figure annual agency deals and consistently hitting individual quota. Strong, current relationships at holding-company agencies; Investment Directors, Planning Directors, Programmatic Leads, and brand-team contacts. Deep fluency in the modern media stack: CTV, programmatic, social, addressable, attention/measurement, and the agency P&L. Comfort selling complex, data-driven products; you can make signal-based, moment-based advertising feel simple to a planner who has 11 other meetings that day. Operating discipline: forecast accuracy, CRM hygiene (HubSpot or Salesforce), pipeline management, and a real point of view on agency sales processes. IT WILL BE A BONUS IF YOU: Experience selling sports media, sports data, or fan-engagement products to major holding companies. Existing relationships at holding-company brand clients (CPG, QSR, auto, financial services, telco). Background in CTV, programmatic, or attention/outcomes-based media sales. Prior experience working under a Holdco lead in a structured holding-company sales model. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. items.location_text: Austin, TX | Remote-Friendly, United States; Boston, MA; New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As the Head of State and Local Government Sales at Anthropic, you'll lead and scale our state and local government sales organization to drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across state agencies, counties, cities, and other local government entities throughout the United States. You'll leverage your deep understanding of state and local government operations and proven sales leadership expertise to build a high-performing team while establishing strategic relationships with key states, municipalities, and public sector partners. Working closely with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll define and execute our go-to-market strategy for the state and local government sector while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance. Key responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a state and local government sales team, including hiring top talent, setting clear performance expectations, and providing ongoing coaching and development Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies for state and local government, including territory design, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and revenue forecasting across a large and geographically distributed customer base Own overall state and local government revenue targets and ensure team performance against quotas, while providing visibility into pipeline health and deal progression Establish and cultivate relationships with governors' offices, state CIOs, agency executives, and city and county leadership, serving as Anthropic's senior point of contact for strategic engagement while empowering your team to own day-to-day customer relationships Win new business across state and local government by helping state agencies, counties, and cities integrate AI into their technology stacks and constituent-facing and back-office workflows to accelerate delivery and improve service outcomes Establish and refine sales processes, methodologies, and playbooks specific to state and local procurement, including cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, RFP/RFI processes, and state-specific compliance requirements Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud service providers, system integrators, and resellers to create scalable go-to-market motions across the state and local market Synthesize market feedback and customer insights to inform product roadmap and competitive strategy, working closely with product and marketing teams Partner with legal, compliance, and delivery teams to ensure successful contract execution and customer satisfaction Implement metrics, reporting, and performance management systems to drive team accountability and continuous improvement Represent Anthropic at industry events and with key stakeholders, establishing our brand as the trusted AI partner for state and local government Minimum qualifications 15+ years of enterprise sales experience with 5+ years managing state and local government sales teams, with a proven track record of scaling revenue and building high-performing organizations Deep understanding of state and local government missions, budget and legislative cycles, modernization initiatives, and technology adoption patterns across multiple states and municipalities Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain top sales talent while creating a culture of performance and accountability Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for emerging technologies in the state and local government space Extensive experience with state and local contracting vehicles, cooperative purchasing agreements, procurement mechanisms, and compliance requirements such as StateRAMP, CJIS, and state-specific data privacy standards Strong track record of consistently exceeding team revenue targets and building predictable, scalable sales motions across a high-volume, distributed territory Proven ability to build and manage strategic channel partnerships and ecosystem relationships, including cloud providers, system integrators, and resellers Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all levels, from technical teams to state CIOs, agency executives, and elected and appointed officials Experience implementing sales methodologies, CRM systems, and performance management processes A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in government contexts and build trust with state and local stakeholders Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $550,000 — $700,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. items.title: Director, Sales Strategy and Operations
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role… We are hiring a Director of Sales Operations to own the operating rhythm of our pre-sales engine globally: Sales, Sales Development, and Sales Engineering. This is a player/coach role leading a small team of experienced senior operators while staying hands-on, and our first Sales Operations leadership seat in North America. This role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations. What you’ll be doing… - Forecasting and pipeline inspection. Own forecast methodology, accuracy, and variance analysis end to end for Sales and Sales Development; run the weekly commit and pipeline inspection cadence; build the leading indicators (stage conversion, velocity, slippage, aged pipeline) that make the forecast defensible before quarter end, not explained after it. - Sales process and policy. Own the pre-sales process architecture: opportunity stages, exit criteria, qualification standards, pipeline hygiene rules, rules of engagement, and the SDR-to-AE handoff, including how conflicts get resolved. - Sales Engineering coverage. Own the SE deployment model (SE-to-AE coverage ratios, prioritization of scarce SE time), standardize the technical proof-of-concept and demo process, and build the reporting that shows technical win-rate. - Territory, quota, and comp. Run territory and quota deployment, exceptions and the audit trail behind them; partner on SE comp and quota-credit design alongside AE and SDR comp. - Partnership with the field. Be the trusted operational partner to Sales, Sales Development, and Sales Engineering leaders in their forecast calls and deal reviews, not adjacent to them; own adoption of process and system change, including manager-level reinforcement. - Cross-functional alignment. Represent the field's requirements into GTM Engineering and Data teams; prioritize, scope, and defend the roadmap. - AI-native operations. Design the pre-sales motion on the assumption AI does the manual work: deal inspection, call-signal extraction, pipeline risk flagging, enrichment, and forecast commentary should be agent-assisted by default. Build and ship those workflows yourself where tooling allows. - Leadership. Lead, develop, and stretch a team of experienced senior operators; manage across US and European time zones; set the prioritization bar and protect the team from reactive demand. We’d love to hear from you if you have… - 8+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy in B2B SaaS, including people management. - B2B SaaS domain expertise, with experience at both small and large B2B SaaS companies. - You have owned a forecast, and can talk methodology, where it broke, and how you fixed it. - Direct experience with Sales Engineering coverage models (SE-to-AE ratios, technical win-rate, POC process), not just Sales and SDR ops. - Deep, current, hands-on Salesforce ability; you diagnose in the object model yourself. - You have put AI or automation into a live sales workflow and can describe the result. - Credible with senior Sales leaders, and C-Level Executives. - Plus: Quantitative degree, Management consulting or Investment Banking background. Our culture At Synthesia, we expect everyone to - Put the Customer First - Own it & Go Direct - Be Fast & Experimental - Make the Journey Fun You can read more about this in this public Notion page https://synthesia.notion.site/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2. Benefits - A competitive salary + stock options in our fast-growing Series E startup - Hybrid working environment - 100% Medical, Dental & Vision - 401k Plan - Paid parental leave - 25 days of annual leave + Public holidays + paid sick leave - Fun culture with regular socials - A generous referral scheme - A brand new computer + monitor

items.title: Hardware Strategic Sourcing & Manufacturing Partnerships Manager
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops silicon and system-level solutions designed for advanced AI workloads. The team builds next-generation AI-native silicon and systems, working closely with software, research, and manufacturing partners to co-design hardware tightly integrated with AI models. Beyond delivering systems for OpenAI’s supercomputing infrastructure, the team develops the strategic partnerships needed to accelerate hardware innovation and scale. About the Role We’re seeking an experienced Hardware Strategic Sourcing & Manufacturing Partnerships Manager to lead strategic engagements with joint design manufacturers (JDMs), contract manufacturers (CMs), and original design manufacturers (ODMs) across OpenAI’s hardware ecosystem. Based in Singapore, you will own the complete manufacturing partner lifecycle: developing sourcing strategies, leading RFIs and RFPs, evaluating and selecting JDM, CM, and ODM partners, negotiating commercial agreements, onboarding suppliers, launching manufacturing programs, and managing long-term partnerships. You will work closely with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, legal, security, and program management teams to establish partnerships supporting AI-native silicon, rack-scale systems, and related infrastructure. Success requires strong commercial judgment, technical credibility, and hands-on operational execution. In this role, you will: - Develop and execute partnership strategies across JDM, CM, and ODM engagement models, identifying the appropriate manufacturing approach based on product requirements, technical complexity, scale, speed, cost, and risk. - Lead end-to-end RFI and RFP processes for prospective JDM, CM, and ODM partners, including defining requirements, conducting market outreach, managing competitive bids, coordinating stakeholder evaluations, and presenting selection recommendations. - Evaluate manufacturing partners across technical capabilities, product design and engineering resources, manufacturing readiness, quality systems, production capacity, financial stability, security, supply-chain resilience, commercial competitiveness, and strategic alignment. - Negotiate and structure JDM, CM, and ODM agreements, including master services agreements, statements of work, engineering and manufacturing responsibilities, nonrecurring engineering, tooling, pricing, capacity commitments, intellectual property, warranties, service levels, and program-specific terms. - Establish clear commercial and operational ownership across partner models, including design responsibilities, engineering deliverables, manufacturing execution, quality accountability, inventory exposure, supply commitments, and escalation procedures. - Develop transparent cost and pricing structures covering bills of materials, engineering services, tooling, manufacturing labor, overhead, margin, volume assumptions, and total cost of ownership. - Apply should-cost analysis, open-book pricing, benchmarking, and cost-down planning to evaluate partner proposals and improve long-term manufacturing economics. - Lead partner onboarding and program bring-up, translating executed agreements into operating plans, resource commitments, technical readiness requirements, program milestones, governance structures, and cross-functional execution. - Coordinate manufacturing readiness, new product introduction, design transfer, production ramp, and ongoing operations with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, finance, and program management teams. - Build and maintain strong executive and working-level relationships with JDM, CM, and ODM partners, serving as the primary commercial point of contact throughout each partnership. - Establish ongoing partner governance through performance scorecards, executive business reviews, delivery and capacity forecasts, corrective action plans, issue escalation, and continuous-improvement initiatives. - Identify and mitigate risks related to manufacturing capacity, supplier concentration, quality, delivery, geopolitical exposure, and continuity across the partner ecosystem. - Develop repeatable frameworks for partner selection, contracting, onboarding, and performance management, while supporting relevant ERP, MRP, and PLM system requirements. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Ten or more years of experience in strategic sourcing, manufacturing partnerships, supplier management, procurement, or supply-chain leadership within hardware, semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, or technology infrastructure. - Direct experience selecting, negotiating with, and managing JDM, CM, and ODM partners supporting complex hardware programs. - A demonstrated understanding of differences among JDM, CM, and ODM business models, including design ownership, engineering responsibilities, manufacturing execution, intellectual property, commercial structures, and operational risk. - Experience leading partner engagements from RFI or RFP through evaluation, selection, contracting, onboarding, new product introduction, production ramp, and ongoing relationship management. - Strong negotiation skills and experience structuring agreements covering engineering services, manufacturing, tooling, capacity, pricing, intellectual property, quality, warranties, and delivery commitments. - Expertise in manufacturing cost models, should-cost analysis, open-book pricing, total cost of ownership, and long-term cost reduction strategies. - Experience bringing new manufacturing programs online and coordinating technical, commercial, and operational readiness across internal teams and external partners. - The technical credibility to collaborate with hardware engineering and manufacturing teams on rack-scale systems, compute infrastructure, networking, storage, silicon, or related hardware. - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to assess tradeoffs among cost, quality, capacity, schedule, technical capability, and operational risk. - A track record of building trusted relationships with manufacturing partners and cross-functional stakeholders; familiarity with manufacturing ecosystems across Asia is valuable. - Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment and building scalable processes where established playbooks do not yet exist. - A commitment to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. To comply with export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
